judgment_text:
The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

Dr G. Jayachandran, J.:— The learned counsel appearing for the appellant submitted that the appellant has opted for the Vivad Se Vishwas (VSVS) scheme and the department has also issued Form-2 to the assessee. Pursuant to this, the tax demand was paid on 10-3-2026

2. In view of these facts, nothing survives in this appeal. Accordingly, the Tax Case appeal stands disposed of.
